code2='''def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c1 in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c1]
            if v==bg: continue
            for c2 in range(c1+1,w):
                if grid[r][c2]!=v: continue
                vert1=any(grid[rr][c1]==v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0<=rr<h)
                vert2=any(grid[rr][c2]==v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0<=rr<h)
                if vert1 and vert2: continue
                for c in range(c1+1,c2):
                    if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    for c in range(w):
        for r1 in range(h):
            v=grid[r1][c]
            if v==bg: continue
            for r2 in range(r1+1,h):
                if grid[r2][c]!=v: continue
                hor1=any(grid[r1][cc]==v for cc in (c-1,c+1) if 0<=cc<w)

                if hor1 and hor2: continue
                for r in range(r1+1,r2):

'''

code3='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Complete short gaps between consecutive marks in each row/column.
    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        for c1, c2 in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            v = grid[r][c1]
            if grid[r][c2] != v or c2-c1 > 5:
                continue
            vertical1 = any(grid[rr][c1] == v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0 <= rr < h)
            vertical2 = any(grid[rr][c2] == v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0 <= rr < h)
            if vertical1 and vertical2:
                continue
            for c in range(c1+1,c2):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        for r1, r2 in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            v = grid[r1][c]
            if grid[r2][c] != v or r2-r1 > 5:

            horizontal1 = any(grid[r1][cc] == v for cc in (c-1,c+1) if 0 <= cc < w)

code4='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Fill gaps between consecutive equal marks; existing crossings stay distinct.
    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        for c1, c2 in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            v = grid[r][c1]
            if grid[r][c2] != v:
                continue
            d = c2-c1
            vertical1 = any(grid[rr][c1] == v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0 <= rr < h)
            vertical2 = any(grid[rr][c2] == v for rr in (r-1,r+1) if 0 <= rr < h)
            if d > 5 or (d == 5 and (vertical1 or vertical2)) or (d <= 4 and vertical1 and vertical2):
                continue
            for c in range(c1+1,c2):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        for r1, r2 in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            v = grid[r1][c]
            if grid[r2][c] != v:
                continue
            horizontal1 = any(grid[r1][cc] == v for cc in (c-1,c+1) if 0 <= cc < w)
            horizontal2 = any(grid[r2][cc] == v for cc in (c-1,c+1) if 0 <= cc < w)
            if horizontal1 and horizontal2:
                continue
            for r in range(r1+1,r2):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
